findings.title: ESLint react-hooks/exhaustive-deps warning in the main game shell
evidence: npm run lint exits 0 with warning (web only)
findings.impact: A stale-closure risk in the primary game component; auth/session effects may not re-run when `gameReady` changes.
findings.recommendation: Fix the dependency array or add a documented eslint-disable with justification.

report: UI/UX/a11y: an axe-core lane (scripts/e2e-a11y-lane.mjs) and a11y Playwright specs run under chromium/firefox/webkit; components have focused tests and a skip-to-main pattern. Residual: `npm run lint` reports one react-hooks/exhaustive-deps warning in Home.tsx (0 errors).
